# Next Digital Level

> Next Digital Level builds premium websites for Australian tradies and local service businesses. The website, logo, Google Business Profile, local SEO and hosting are included for one payment of $499 (Black Friday price, usually $999). We build the website first and show it to the client; they only pay if they love it.

- How it works: message us on WhatsApp and answer 3 quick questions; we build a free preview; we walk the client through it on a 10 minute call; once approved, the website goes live within 48 hours.
- No monthly fees. Unlimited changes for the first 3 months, then optional ongoing changes at $30 a month or $300 a year.
- The client owns the website once it is paid. They buy their own domain name and we connect it.
- Trades: plumbers, electricians, roofers, cleaners, landscapers, beauty salons and other local service businesses across Australia.
- Rated 5 stars on Google.
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +61 488 894 068 · contact@nextdigitalevel.com · 475 Spencer St, West Melbourne VIC 3003, Australia.
